scope: Full chronological sanitized projection through the frozen cutoff; every original record has an index and original-line hash. Primary user/assistant/tool messages are preserved except explicit redactions. Private runtime instructions, encrypted reasoning, duplicate event contents, internal state and image/audio/video attachments are replaced with typed hash tombstones. Not byte-identical to the private raw export; original retained locally. No OpenCode usage, human approval, independent signature or missing historical response is reconstructed.
annotation_method: Codex indexes actual user messages and identifies explicit behavior, scoring, testing and deletion requests by original record; interpretations await owner review, not independent signatures.
